fineRound.title: Fine round
fineRound.intro: Hand out fines and send debt warnings in one go. Fined users get a single email that also warns them about the next round; users who are only in debt now get a warning.
fineRound.explanation: Users who are at most -€5 on both dates will be fined, based on their balance on the measurement date. Users who are at most -€5 only on the measurement date will get a warning instead.
fineRound.invalidDates: The previous measurement date must be before the measurement date.
fineRound.finesInfo: These users were in debt on both dates and will be fined. They receive one email that also warns them about the next measurement.
fineRound.deselectedNote: Deselected users are skipped entirely: they are not fined and not warned.
fineRound.warningsInfo: These users are in debt now, but were not at the previous measurement. They will only receive a warning.
fineRound.summary: {fined} users will be fined a total of {amount} and {warned} users will be warned, based on balances on {date}.
